generatedCommentsNodes.comment: Comparing floating-point numbers using `==` can be unreliable due to precision issues. If the values in `lons` are results of calculations rather than exact literals, consider using `Double.compare()` or checking if the difference is within a small epsilon (e.g., `Math.abs(v - 180) < EPSILON`).
